description: Reviewed Cyprus Labor Watch MVP records. Public records must keep at least one stable public source URL.

records.title: Electricity Authority of Cyprus 24-hour island-wide strike
records.summary: Electricity Authority of Cyprus workers staged a 24-hour island-wide strike on 23 April 2026. Customer service centres and offices were closed while safety staff were kept in place to avoid disruption to power supply.
records.labor_organization: EPOPAI, SIDIKEK, SEPAIK, SYVAIK, Free Pancyprian Organisation of EAC Personnel

locations.label: Island-wide EAC strike
locations.location_basis: Island-wide strike; centroid used only for map placement.

timeline.note: Unions announced the decision to escalate to a 24-hour strike.
The 24-hour work stoppage ran from midnight to midnight.

sources.title: EAC workers stage 24-hour island-wide strike
EAC Workers to Stage 24-Hour Strike on April 23

records.title: EAC workers two-hour warning strike
records.summary: Electricity Authority of Cyprus workers held a two-hour warning strike on 27 February 2026 over government energy policy, Cyta's planned entry into the energy market, and unresolved labour issues at the authority.
demands: Withdrawal of energy-market legislation affecting EAC

locations.label: EAC offices and customer service centres
locations.location_basis: Strike affected EAC offices across Cyprus; centroid used only for map placement.

timeline.note: Two-hour strike took place in the morning.

sources.title: EAC workers strike over 'erratic' govt policy, Cyta expansion into energy

records.title: Wolt delivery riders' Limassol strike
records.summary: Wolt delivery riders in Limassol launched industrial action over falling pay rates and safety concerns. Riders described the action as both a strike and a protest, with the possibility of expansion to other cities if their concerns were not addressed.

locations.label: Limassol delivery rider action
locations.location_basis: City-level action; centroid used pending exact gathering points.

timeline.note: Riders launched industrial action in Limassol.
Cyprus Mail reported threats to striking riders from a Wolt recruiter.

sources.title: Wolt delivery riders in Limassol take industrial action over falling pay rates, safety issues
Wolt recruiter threatens striking riders with the sack

records.title: Education support programme workers' 24-hour strike
records.summary: Employees in education ministry support programmes announced a 24-hour strike for 26 March 2026 and a protest outside the presidential palace. PASEY-PEO and OEKDY-SEK said workers rejected delays and proposals that ignored labour rights and court rulings.
records.employer: Ministry of Education, Sport and Youth support programmes
demands: Abolition of the purchasing-services employment regime

timeline.note: Unions announced the 24-hour strike decision.
Strike and presidential palace protest date.

sources.title: Education support staff to stage 24-hour strike on March 26

records.title: Taxi drivers' 24-hour pan-Cypriot strike
records.summary: Taxi drivers across Cyprus launched a 24-hour strike on 20 January 2026 after an earlier work stoppage failed to resolve their demands. The Cyprus Urban Taxi Union said the dispute centred on legality and fair application of rules in the taxi sector.

locations.label: Pan-Cypriot taxi strike
locations.location_basis: Island-wide strike; centroid used only for map placement.

timeline.note: Twenty-four-hour strike began at 6 a.m.

sources.title: Taxi drivers launch 24-hour strike across Cyprus

records.title: Three-hour nationwide CoLA general strike
records.summary: Workers across Cyprus held a three-hour general strike on 11 September 2025 demanding full implementation and protection of the Cost-of-Living Adjustment and extension of CoLA coverage to all employees.
records.labor_organization: PEO, SEK, DEOK, PASYDY and other unions

locations.label: Nationwide CoLA strike
locations.location_basis: Nationwide stoppage; centroid used only for map placement.

timeline.note: Unions called the strike after CoLA talks failed.
Three-hour stoppage took place from 11:00 to 14:00.

sources.title: Three-hour general strike over CoLA in Cyprus, several sectors affected
Nationwide strike paralyses Cyprus over cost-of-living allowance

records.title: Turkish Cypriot public-sector CoLA strikes
records.summary: Turkish Cypriot public-sector unions staged strikes and protests in North Nicosia in April 2026 over measures affecting cost-of-living allowance payments. Mobilisations centred on the assembly building and continued across several days.
records.labor_organization: KTAMS, Türk-Sen, El-Sen and other Turkish Cypriot unions
demands: Withdrawal of CoLA decree and bill

timeline.note: General strike and protest action escalated around the assembly building.
Demonstrations continued and clashes were reported.
Further strike action and warnings of continued mobilisation were reported.

sources.title: Calls Grow for Ruling Coalition to Step Down Over CoLA Cuts

records.title: El-Sen president Ahmet Tugcu detained during CoLA protests
records.summary: El-Sen president Ahmet Tugcu was detained during protests outside the Turkish Cypriot assembly on 7 April 2026 and released later that evening. Reports said charges were read after his release and that Tugcu rejected the accusations.
records.accusation: Riot, obstructing police, intentional damage according to defence statements reported by Ajans Cyprus

timeline.note: Sigmalive reported that Tugcu was arrested during the unrest.
Ajans Cyprus reported that Tugcu was released around 20:30.

sources.title: Protests during Turkish Cypriot strike over cost-of-living adjustments

records.title: Construction worker dies after fall in Lakatamia
records.summary: A 43-year-old third-country national construction worker died after falling from an apartment block under construction in Lakatamia. PEO said the incident reflected weaknesses in workplace safety oversight and called for stronger training and inspections.
records.legal_status: Police and labour-safety context reported; specific case outcome not published in source

timeline.note: Worker died after a fall at an under-construction apartment block.
PEO issued a statement linking the death to safety oversight weaknesses.

sources.title: PEO: worker's death not an 'unfortunate event'

records.title: Finis Alexandru killed during counterweight unloading in Kofinou
records.summary: Finis Alexandru, a 55-year-old Romanian worker employed by a private company assembling pylons for the Electricity Authority of Cyprus, was fatally struck by a heavy concrete counterweight during unloading operations near Kofinou.
records.employer: Private pylon assembly contractor for EAC
records.cause: Truck tipped during unloading and concrete counterweight struck worker
records.legal_status: Police and Department of Labour Inspection investigation; truck driver arrested under warrant according to source

timeline.note: Fatal unloading accident occurred in the afternoon.
KNEWS reported police and labour-inspector investigations.

sources.title: Tragic workplace accident claims life of 55-year-old worker in Kofinou

records.title: Aldahdouh Housain killed by falling timber in Peyia
records.summary: Aldahdouh Housain, a 34-year-old Syrian construction worker, died after a timber load fell from a forklift in Peyia. Police arrested the forklift driver and project contractor for questioning, according to the Cyprus Mail.
records.employer: Construction project contractor not named in source
records.cause: Crushed by timber load after securing belt snapped
records.legal_status: Police investigation; forklift driver and project contractor held for questioning according to source

locations.label: Parking area near Church of St George

timeline.note: Worker was injured and later died at Paphos General Hospital.
Cyprus Mail reported the police investigation.

records.summary: Gela Kaltsidis, a 47-year-old Georgian construction worker, died after falling from the sixth floor of a building under construction in Limassol. KNEWS reported that police and the Department of Labour Inspection were investigating.

records.title: PEO May Day gatherings and Ledra Palace joint march
records.summary: Workers and trade union members held May Day gatherings across Cyprus in 2026, including a central Nicosia gathering at Eleftheria Square and marches from both sides of the divided capital to Ledra Palace in the buffer zone.

el.title: Πρωτομαγιάτικες συγκεντρώσεις της ΠΕΟ και κοινή πορεία στο Ledra Palace
el.summary: Εργαζόμενοι και μέλη συντεχνιών τίμησαν την Εργατική Πρωτομαγιά του 2026 με εκδηλώσεις σε όλη την Κύπρο. Στη Λευκωσία έγινε κεντρική συγκέντρωση στην πλατεία Ελευθερίας και πορείες από τις δύο πλευρές της διαιρεμένης πόλης προς το Ledra Palace στη νεκρή ζώνη.

records.title: Livestock farmers' Rizoelia roundabout protest over foot-and-mouth measures
records.summary: The group Voice of Livestock Farmers called a protest for 8 May 2026 at the Rizoelia roundabout over the handling of foot-and-mouth disease measures, culling, losses, and compensation. Public reporting said police would be deployed to maintain public order and traffic flow, while organisers said the action would take place around 11:00 at the roundabout.
demands: Resolution of foot-and-mouth disease measures affecting livestock farmers
Compensation and support for livestock farmers' losses

locations.label: Rizoelia roundabout
locations.location_basis: Sources place the protest at or around the Rizoelia roundabout, including the motorway junction connecting Larnaca with Nicosia and Ayia Napa; approximate interchange point used.

timeline.note: Public reporting from CNA/Politis said livestock farmers would gather again at Rizoelia roundabout on 8 May at 11:00.
Cyprus Mail reported police would be deployed in the Rizoelia area for the planned protest.
Planned protest date at Rizoelia roundabout over foot-and-mouth disease measures and compensation.

tr.title: Hayvancılardan şap hastalığı önlemleri için Rizoelia kavşağı protestosu
tr.summary: Hayvancıların Sesi grubu, şap hastalığına ilişkin önlemler, hayvan itlafları, kayıplar ve tazminat sürecinin ele alınışına karşı 8 Mayıs 2026'da Rizoelia kavşağında protesto çağrısı yaptı. Kamuya açık haberlerde polisin kamu düzenini ve trafik akışını korumak için bölgede olacağı, örgütleyicilerin ise eylemin saat 11:00 civarında kavşakta yapılacağını söylediği aktarıldı.

el.title: Διαμαρτυρία κτηνοτρόφων στον κυκλικό κόμβο Ριζοελιάς για τα μέτρα αφθώδους πυρετού
el.summary: Η Φωνή των Κτηνοτρόφων κάλεσε σε διαμαρτυρία στις 8 Μαΐου 2026 στον κυκλικό κόμβο Ριζοελιάς για τον χειρισμό των μέτρων κατά του αφθώδους πυρετού, των θανατώσεων ζώων, των απωλειών και των αποζημιώσεων. Δημόσιες αναφορές ανέφεραν ότι η αστυνομία θα βρισκόταν στην περιοχή για τη διατήρηση της δημόσιας τάξης και της κυκλοφορίας, ενώ οι διοργανωτές είπαν ότι η κινητοποίηση θα γινόταν γύρω στις 11:00 στον κόμβο.
demands: Επίλυση των μέτρων για τον αφθώδη πυρετό που επηρεάζουν τους κτηνοτρόφους
Αποζημίωση και στήριξη για τις απώλειες των κτηνοτρόφων

rizoelia-roundabout-livestock-protest-ma.label: Κυκλικός κόμβος Ριζοελιάς
rizoelia-roundabout-livestock-protest-ma.location_basis: Οι πηγές τοποθετούν τη διαμαρτυρία στον κυκλικό κόμβο Ριζοελιάς και στον οδικό κόμβο που συνδέει τη Λάρνακα με τη Λευκωσία και την Αγία Νάπα. Χρησιμοποιήθηκε προσεγγιστικό σημείο του κόμβου.

timeline: Δημόσιες αναφορές από ΚΥΠΕ/Politis ανέφεραν ότι οι κτηνοτρόφοι θα συγκεντρώνονταν ξανά στον κυκλικό κόμβο Ριζοελιάς στις 8 Μαΐου στις 11:00.
Το Cyprus Mail ανέφερε ότι η αστυνομία θα αναπτυσσόταν στην περιοχή Ριζοελιάς για την προγραμματισμένη διαμαρτυρία.
Προγραμματισμένη ημερομηνία διαμαρτυρίας στον κυκλικό κόμβο Ριζοελιάς για τα μέτρα αφθώδους πυρετού και τις αποζημιώσεις.
